final_content: {"status":"answer","answer":"Three different types of citrus fruit: lime, orange, and lemon.","claims":[{"claim":"The user used lime in cocktail recipes, including a classic Daiquiri and a Cucumber Gimlet.","citations":[{"evidence_id":"E00002","quote":"I recently learned how to make a classic Daiquiri the right way, using fresh lime juice and simple syrup in a mixology class."},{"evidence_id":"E00004","quote":"I recently made a Cucumber Gimlet by infusing the gin with sliced cucumbers and mixed it with lime juice and simple syrup - it was a hit at my last party!"}]},{"claim":"The user also used orange and lemon in Sangria served at a prior dinner party.","citations":[{"evidence_id":"E00003","quote":"I'm thinking of serving the Sangria in a large pitcher with slices of orange and lemon, just like I did for my dinner party two weeks ago."}]},{"claim":"The distinct citrus types identified are lime, orange, and lemon, for a total of three.","citations":[{"evidence_id":"E00002","quote":"I recently learned how to make a classic Daiquiri the right way, using fresh lime juice and simple syrup in a mixology class."},{"evidence_id":"E00003","quote":"I'm thinking of serving the Sangria in a large pitcher with slices of orange and lemon, just like I did for my dinner party two weeks ago."},{"evidence_id":"E00004","quote":"I recently made a Cucumber Gimlet by infusing the gin with sliced cucumbers and mixed it with lime juice and simple syrup - it was a hit at my last party!"}]}],"selected_sources":["C02","C03","C04"],"missing":"No evidence shows the user using grapefruit or any other citrus type in their own cocktail recipes."}
